messages:
aria: Heads-up — starting the model-route v4 deploy in ~30m. Plan: pin v3 as rollback target, FF ramp 5% -> 25% -> 100% with holds. Change window until 02:00 UTC. Release notes linked in the doc. Any objections?

sam: sounds good. canary at 5% for 10m first, then 25% if metrics look stable. i'll watch p95 and 5xx :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by aria (ts=1623456789). JobID: db-9071. Status: QUEUED.

jordan: please add a quick manual-pin snippet to the release notes: `curl -X POST https://infra.internal/admin/pin?service=model-route&version=v3` — helpful during rollbacks.

maria: noted. rollback criteria proposal: 1) p95 latency > 400ms sustained for 5m, 2) 5xx > 0.5% for 3m, 3) hallucination/regression spike on the smoke eval set. if triggered: set FF -> 0% + pin v3. i'll wire up alerts.

sam: i'll create a temp dashboard and add a quicklink to the ff toggle endpoint. autoscaling remains on.

aria: reminder command for graceful unpin if needed: `deployctl ff set model-route-v4 0 --drain-seconds 60` — use this before forcing a pin to avoid connection churn.

deploy-bot: Job db-9071: DEPLOY STARTED (canary=5%).

deploy-bot: Canary report — cpu 54%, p95 120ms, errors 0.02%. CANARY OK.

aria: ramp to 25% now.

deploy-bot: FF updated: model-route-v4 -> 25% rollout. Job db-9071 progress: 25%.

sam: seeing a small p95 jitter (+30ms) but under the 400ms threshold. holding at 25% for 20m.

jordan: quick reminder to include in release notes: exact disable steps + alert thresholds (p95 > 400ms, 5xx > 0.5%). makes on-call life easier.

aria: agreed. final plan is to finish to 100% at or before 02:00 UTC if no alerts. huge thanks — ping me immediately if anything looks off. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Job db-9071: ROLLFORWARD COMPLETE. FF at 100%. Release tag: v4-deploy-2021-06-11.
